rules.rule: Flag a path that overwrites, follows, renames, or removes an unmanaged native OpenCode file or symlink. Only manifest-owned managed relative symlinks may be cleaned up; give a concrete filesystem state that violates that boundary.

Flag decoding or linking changes that accept malformed/unsupported V1 or V2 agent metadata, silently widen effective permissions, or override an explicitly configured native OpenCode agent or command. Identify the candidate frontmatter or collision.

Flag a reproducible path traversal, symlink-parent, lock-race, or watcher cleanup failure that crosses the declared discovery root, deletes another instance's state, or leaves unmanaged links behind. Distinguish a reload signal from a guaranteed host rescan.
